note: Classifier stage-1 spectrum: coarse buckets scored by a System-1 decision model (Kev) via llama.cpp /v1/systemone, one call per article. Relevance is asked as independent binary questions, never a forced 3-way ranking (which yields inauthentic mid-range scores). The character model resolves relationship, attribution and time from the complete source text.

relevance.direct_subject.instructions: Is the candidate target a direct subject of the reported event, assertion or reaction — not a passing mention?

relevance.opponent_context.instructions: Is the candidate target an opponent or contextual counterparty in another subject's reporting?

emotional_charge.instructions: Does the text carry emotional charge — hope, anger, joy, worry, relief or frustration — rather than flat reporting? Apathy is not emotional charge.

availability.instructions: Does this report discuss the target's physical availability — injury, fitness or suspension?

movement.instructions: Is a transfer, trade, signing or departure involving the target discussed?

staffing.instructions: Does this report discuss a coaching or staff appointment, sacking or role change?

scout.note: Nomination only; Scout still requires an applied structured record.

journalist.note: Broad: reporting whose target is a direct subject. The character refines relationship from the text.
